title: UK Diesel Prices Hit Record Highs as Global Tensions Grow
subtitle: Rising fuel costs are putting pressure on businesses and families across the country

summary.en: The price of diesel in the UK has reached a record high of 199.18p per litre. This increase is largely driven by ongoing conflicts in the Middle East and reduced oil production. Experts warn that these higher costs will likely lead to more expensive goods for consumers. The government is currently under pressure to provide more financial support at the pumps. Meanwhile, international leaders are considering new policies to try and stabilize the energy market.
summary.zh: 英國的柴油價格已達到每公升 199.18 便士的歷史新高。這波漲勢主要由中東持續的衝突與石油產量減少所驅動。專家警告，這些較高的成本很可能導致消費者面臨更昂貴的商品。政府目前面臨壓力，需在加油站提供更多財務支援。與此同時，國際領袖正考慮採取新政策，試圖穩定能源市場。

paragraphs.en: Drivers across the United Kingdom are facing a difficult situation at the fuel pump as the price of diesel has reached an all-time high. According to data reported by The Guardian, the average cost of diesel on UK forecourts has climbed to 199.18p per litre. This figure surpasses the previous record set back in June 2022. For many families, the cost of filling a standard car with diesel has now risen to nearly £110, which is a significant increase of 40% since late February.
paragraphs.zh: 英國各地的駕駛人正面臨加油站的艱難處境，因為柴油價格已達到歷史新高。根據《衛報 (The Guardian)》報導的數據，英國加油站的柴油平均成本已攀升至每公升 199.18 便士。此數字超越了 2022 年 6 月創下的前紀錄。對許多家庭而言，加滿一輛標準汽車柴油的費用現已漲至近 110 英鎊，自 2 月下旬以來大幅增加了 40%。

paragraphs.en: This sharp rise is closely linked to ongoing instability in the Middle East. The conflict has made it harder to transport oil through critical shipping routes, such as the strait of Hormuz. Hopes for a peace deal were recently dashed when Donald Trump rejected a proposal from Iran that could have reopened these important trade paths. As a result, the global price of oil has remained high, recently climbing to $106.5 per barrel. The International Energy Agency also noted that global oil output has been affected by drone attacks on Russian refineries, which have caused production to fall to a 20-year low.
paragraphs.zh: 這波急劇上漲與中東地區持續的不穩定局勢密切相關。衝突使得透過荷莫茲海峽等關鍵航運路線運輸石油變得更加困難。川普 (Donald Trump) 最近拒絕了伊朗提出的一項可能重啟這些重要貿易路徑的提議，導致和平協議的希望破滅。結果，全球油價持續居高不下，近期攀升至每桶 106.5 美元。國際能源總署 (International Energy Agency) 也指出，全球石油產量受到無人機攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠的影響，導致產量降至 20 年來的最低點。

paragraphs.en: Simon Williams, head of policy at the RAC, a major motoring organisation, described the situation as "uncharted territory." He warned that the pain is not limited to car owners. Because the UK economy relies heavily on lorries and vans to move products, these higher fuel costs will eventually affect almost everyone. "Undoubtedly, these increased costs will be passed on to consumers," Williams explained. This means that everyday items found on supermarket shelves, as well as goods in the construction and manufacturing sectors, are likely to become more expensive as businesses try to cover their rising transport bills.
paragraphs.zh: 英國主要汽車組織英國皇家汽車俱樂部 (RAC) 的政策主管賽門·威廉斯 (Simon Williams) 將此情況形容為「未知的領域」。他警告說，痛苦不僅限於車主。由於英國經濟高度依賴貨車與卡車來運輸產品，這些較高的燃料成本最終將影響每一個人。威廉斯解釋道：「毫無疑問，這些增加的成本將轉嫁給消費者。」這意味著超市貨架上的日常用品，以及建築與製造業的商品，隨著企業試圖負擔日益增加的運輸帳單，價格很可能會變得更貴。

paragraphs.en: Experts in supply chain management agree that the impact will be widespread. Dr. Jonathan Owens from the University of Salford noted that a geopolitical event—a conflict involving different countries—thousands of miles away can quickly move through the supply chain. He explained that the cost travels from the refinery to the tanker, then to the haulier, and finally to the shop shelf. Because of this, the final price is almost always paid by the person buying the product at the end of the line.
paragraphs.zh: 供應鏈管理專家一致認為，這種影響將會非常廣泛。索爾福德大學 (University of Salford) 的強納森·歐文斯 (Jonathan Owens) 博士指出，數千英里外發生的地緣政治事件——即涉及不同國家的衝突——可以迅速透過供應鏈傳導。他解釋說，成本從煉油廠傳遞到油輪，再到運輸業者，最後到達商店貨架。正因如此，最終價格幾乎總是由終端購買產品的人來承擔。

paragraphs.en: In response to these challenges, the UK government has extended a 5p cut in fuel duty—a tax on petrol and diesel—until the end of the year. However, the RAC has urged officials to consider doing more, such as reducing VAT or expanding the current discount. There is concern that if the fuel duty cut is fully removed by next spring, it will add even more pressure to already struggling households. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has suggested that the United States might consider a ban on diesel exports to help lower prices, and has also asked Ukraine to limit strikes on Russian oil facilities to prevent further global price spikes.
paragraphs.zh: 為了應對這些挑戰，英國政府已將燃料稅（針對汽油與柴油徵收的稅款）的 5 便士減免措施延長至今年年底。然而，英國皇家汽車俱樂部已敦促官員考慮採取更多措施，例如降低加值型營業稅或擴大目前的折扣。外界擔憂，如果燃料稅減免在明年春天完全取消，將對本已掙扎的家庭增加更多壓力。與此同時，川普建議美國或許可以考慮禁止柴油出口以協助降低價格，並要求烏克蘭限制對俄羅斯石油設施的攻擊，以防止全球價格進一步飆升。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the cost of oil, there is also the issue of how fuel retailers set their prices. A report published in August by the Competition and Markets Authority, the UK agency responsible for ensuring fair business practices, found that many petrol stations were slow to lower their prices even when wholesale energy costs fell. While the watchdog did not find evidence that companies were intentionally overcharging, it did note that profit margins for retailers have remained at historically high levels. This has led to frustration among motorists who feel that price drops at the global level are not being reflected quickly enough at their local stations.
paragraphs.zh: 除了油價之外，燃料零售商如何制定價格也是一個問題。負責確保公平商業行為的英國機構競爭與市場管理局 (Competition and Markets Authority) 在 8 月發布的一份報告發現，許多加油站在批發能源成本下降時，調降價格的速度相當緩慢。雖然該監管機構並未發現企業蓄意超收費用的證據，但確實指出零售商的利潤率仍維持在歷史高點。這導致駕駛人感到挫折，他們認為全球層面的價格下跌並未迅速反映在當地的加油站。

paragraphs.en: As the situation develops, the outlook remains uncertain. With the price of diesel potentially moving toward the £2 mark, many sectors of the UK economy are bracing for a difficult period. Whether through government intervention or changes in international policy, finding a way to stabilize these costs has become a top priority. For now, both businesses and individual drivers are being forced to adjust their budgets to manage the rising costs of travel and trade.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著局勢發展，前景依然不明朗。由於柴油價格可能邁向 2 英鎊大關，英國經濟的許多部門正準備迎接一段艱難時期。無論是透過政府干預還是國際政策的改變，找到穩定這些成本的方法已成為首要任務。目前，企業與個別駕駛人都被迫調整預算，以應對日益增加的交通與貿易成本。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To destroy or ruin someone's hopes or expectations.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 使（希望、計畫等）破滅、落空。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（猛衝），這裡指希望破滅。文中：Hopes for a peace deal were recently dashed when Donald Trump rejected a proposal from Iran that could have reopened these important trade paths.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To give the cost of something to someone else, usually by increasing the price of goods or services.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指企業將成本轉嫁給消費者，而非字面上的「傳遞」。文中："Undoubtedly, these increased costs will be passed on to consumers," Williams explained.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To prepare for something difficult or unpleasant that is about to happen.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 準備應對（困難或不愉快的事）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（支撐物），這裡指心理準備。文中：With the price of diesel potentially moving toward the £2 mark, many sectors of the UK economy are bracing for a difficult period.

quiz.question: By what percentage has the cost of filling a standard diesel car increased since the end of February?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確指出填充一輛標準柴油車的成本自二月底以來增加了 40%，總金額接近 110 英鎊。選項 A 混淆了數字，選項 C 將總金額誤認為百分比，選項 D 則是每公升的價格數字，皆非題目所問的漲幅百分比。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the cost of a loaf of bread in a UK supermarket rise in the coming months?

options.A: Because the government is planning to increase the VAT on all food items.
options.B: Because retailers are intentionally overcharging customers to increase their profits.
options.C: Because the increased cost of transporting goods will be passed down the supply chain to the final consumer.
options.D: Because global oil production has reached a 20-year high, causing market instability.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第三段與第四段，Simon Williams 與 Dr. Jonathan Owens 皆指出，運輸燃料成本上升會導致物流費用增加，而這些成本最終會由企業轉嫁給消費者，反映在超市架上的商品價格中。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 B 雖提到零售商利潤高，但並未證實是「故意超收」；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到的是產量降至 20 年來最低。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the phrase 'uncharted territory' mean in the context of Simon Williams' statement?

options.A: A situation that is completely new and lacks a clear plan or historical precedent.
options.B: A geographic area that has not been mapped by modern explorers.
options.C: A dangerous location where fuel prices are significantly lower than average.
options.D: A period of time where the government has lost control over the economy.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「uncharted territory」是一種比喻用法，意指當前的經濟狀況前所未見，沒有過去的經驗可供參考或應對。選項 B 是字面上的地理含義，不符語境；選項 C 與 D 均為錯誤推論，文中並未暗示該地區危險或政府失去控制，僅強調情況的未知性與嚴峻性。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current fuel situation in the UK?

options.A: The UK government has successfully solved the diesel crisis through tax cuts.
options.B: The high cost of fuel is primarily caused by local petrol stations refusing to lower prices.
options.C: The global oil market is stable, but UK consumers are suffering due to poor management.
options.D: Rising global fuel costs, driven by geopolitical instability, are creating widespread economic pressure across the UK.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章整體主旨聚焦於全球地緣政治（如中東衝突、俄羅斯煉油廠遇襲）如何導致油價飆升，進而透過供應鏈影響英國的物價與經濟。選項 A 錯誤，政府僅是延長減稅；選項 B 僅是文中提到的次要因素之一；選項 C 錯誤，全球市場並不穩定，且問題根源在於國際因素而非單純的管理不善。
